text:
On Saturday 12 September (10:42am–1:17pm AEST), about half of card payments at checkout failed. Cause: connector B pinned an expired intermediate certificate after the vendor's August renewal.

**Impact:** 2,391 of 4,812 attempts failed. 1,940 customers retried successfully; 451 abandoned, an estimated $41,900 in lost revenue (some may buy later). Support contacts were about four times normal (312).

**Detection was slow:** alerts didn't fire because failures were split across connectors. Support escalation led to the fix.

**Actions:**
- Certificate pinning removed (done)
- 10% goodwill code sent (done)
- Overall checkout failure alert (SRE, 17 Oct)
- Certificate expiry added to vendor checks (Security, 31 Oct)
